command: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format=json -- -W clippy::allow_attributes -W clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason -W clippy::await_holding_lock -W clippy::await_holding_refcell_ref -W clippy::borrowed_box -W clippy::cast_possible_truncation -W clippy::derive_ord_xor_partial_ord -W clippy::derived_hash_with_manual_eq -W clippy::exhaustive_enums -W clippy::exhaustive_structs -W clippy::indexing_slicing -W clippy::iter_over_hash_type -W clippy::map_err_ignore -W clippy::missing_errors_doc -W clippy::missing_panics_doc -W clippy::missing_safety_doc -W clippy::needless_range_loop -W clippy::new_without_default -W clippy::ptr_arg -W clippy::redundant_clone -W clippy::result_unit_err -W clippy::should_implement_trait -W clippy::string_add -W clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks -W clippy::unnecessary_unwrap -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::wildcard_imports -W clippy::wrong_self_convention -W missing_debug_implementations -W missing_docs

findings.message: docs for function which may panic missing `# Panics` section
findings.fix: Add # Panics, or remove the panic.
Propagate with ?, or use expect and state why the value cannot be missing.

findings.message: public fn exposes a boxed dynamic error
findings.fix: Return a named error type; keep the boxed form inside binaries.

findings.message: public fn exposes a boxed dynamic error
findings.fix: Return a named error type; keep the boxed form inside binaries.

findings.message: public fn exposes an anyhow type
findings.fix: Return a named error type and let the application wrap it with anyhow.

findings.message: catch_unwind with no comment naming the boundary
findings.fix: Return a Result instead, or comment the boundary that needs the catch.

findings.message: public fn takes a bool parameter
findings.fix: Use a two-variant enum, or split into two named functions.

findings.message: type name says nothing about what it models
findings.fix: Name the type for the thing it models.
Use from_le_bytes, TryFrom, a match, or a safe wrapper type.

findings.message: unsafe impl of Send or Sync with no SAFETY comment
findings.fix: Fix the type so the auto trait holds, or document the invariant that makes it sound.
Hide a fn main returning Result in the example and use ?.
Remove it and pass -D warnings in CI.
Propagate the poison, or reset the data with a reason on record.

judgment.rule: No clone exists only to quiet the borrow checker.
Each expect, assert and panic message carries the values that made it fire.
